definition: Removing or adding one part of a system at a time to attribute its contribution, and in both sources here the interesting result is what the ablation reveals that an accuracy delta alone would not. The unlearning work adds its components cumulatively on top of a crude lexical baseline and reports a trade at the final step rather than stopping at the best headline: the last component slightly worsens forgetting while raising generation fluency and retained utility. The reflection work goes further and tracks each individual reward component across training steps rather than only its endpoint, which turns a quantitative claim into a categorical one -- with one advantage term removed, the rewards it governs do not merely improve less, they fail to optimise at all, and with the other removed a different reward collapses during training. That is much stronger evidence that a decomposition is doing decomposition work than a drop in average accuracy, because it shows which objective stopped moving rather than only that the total fell. Both sources also demonstrate the design's main weakness: a cumulative ablation fixes an ordering, so it measures each component conditional on the ones already present and cannot separate a component's own effect from its interaction with them -- which is what a full factorial does instead.

evidence.note: Separates hallucination into a reasoning failure and a knowledge failure, treats the first with a structured reflect-before-answering format and the second with a reward for abstaining when no sampled chain succeeds, and shows the two mechanisms are not interchangeable -- reflection alone never abstains, abstention alone never lowers the hallucination proxy.
evidence.title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment

evidence.note: Replaces the monotonic zoom-in that tool-using video agents follow once they pick a region with a policy that self-checks each tool observation and can switch regions, and trains it with turn-level credit applied multiplicatively -- reweighting the trajectory advantage's magnitude while preserving its sign -- rather than additively.
evidence.title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning

evidence.note: Models hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components and derives a closed-form Wiener filter over their covariances, giving mode-wise attenuation that is folded back into the model's own weights so inference runs unchanged and at the same speed.
evidence.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression

evidence.note: Builds a dense process reward without a learned verifier or an online judge, by aligning generated reasoning steps to the process-labelled reference steps that existing datasets already contain using numerical, symbolic and lexical matching rules, gated so a partial reference match cannot override a wrong final answer.
evidence.title: StructReward: Efficient Structured Process Rewards for Self-Correcting Multimodal Reasoning

evidence.note: Replaces the single tolerance threshold that RLVR uses to score floating-point answers with a hybrid reward pairing a hard clinical-safety constraint against a continuous precision-sensitive term, and adds a reward for stating the computational formula explicitly so an external verifier can check it.
evidence.title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning

evidence.note: Traces the brittleness of multimodal RLVR gains under paraphrase and template change to two properties of the standard objective -- a binary verifier that cannot distinguish a wrong answer from a misformatted one, and a training distribution covering a thin slice of the prompts a deployed model meets -- and fixes both with a trinary reward and an invariance penalty across semantically equivalent prompts.
evidence.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR

evidence.note: Reads a frozen vision-language model's forward pass as a structured computational trace -- a graph over image patches, query tokens and generated tokens with attention as edges, processed by interleaved relational, spatial and sequential modules -- and shows that structuring the same internals prior detectors already read lifts hallucination detection from a 69-75 AUC plateau to 90.
evidence.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations

evidence.note: Replaces a verbose natural-language rationale with two to six executable action tokens drawn from a fixed vocabulary, supervised automatically by pairing logged trajectories with scene context, so that driving-oriented reasoning fits inside a real-time control budget that verbose chain-of-thought exceeds by three to four times.
evidence.title: XCoT-VLA: Executable Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Driving

evidence.note: Points out that the group-relative policy gradient is a second-order U-statistic over pairs of rollouts rather than a sum of independent per-rollout contributions, and reallocates rollout compute accordingly -- treating prefixes as vertices and pair-gradient terms as edges, then correcting the resulting selection bias by inverse joint-inclusion weighting.
evidence.title: PAIR: Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting for Adaptive Rollout Allocation in RLVR

evidence.note: Finds that a fact successfully unlearned from a multimodal model's final answer can still be reproduced in its reasoning trace, far more in natively RL-trained models than in their base versions, and uses the token-level entropy signature RL leaves behind as a training-free control signal for redirecting the trace at decoding time.
evidence.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

evidence.note: Gives a search agent an explicitly reversible trajectory tree with reflect and backtrack as first-class actions, and trains the reflection policy with a dense local signal distilled from a teacher that can see the whole trajectory alongside the sparse terminal reward the local decision is ultimately judged by.
evidence.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation

name: component ablation
